occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One caregiver and director did not have a current transportation training certificate to provide to licensing during the inspection.

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: A playground swing and slide structure did not have the required surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zone around the stationary playground equipment does not meet the 6 feet perimeter requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: The director and caregivers did not have the skill based CPR training certificate available for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less: The use zone in front of the slide did not have the required 6 feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Six Feet High or Less (26 TAC §746.4805(b))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone of the slide was not the required 6 feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: I observed brown ceiling tiles in the primary room. The tiles appears to have a dip in them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: 2 out off 2 caregivers did not have 24 hours of annual training completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have 30 hours of annual training completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out 4 children files reviewed did not have a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: A broken tricycle was observed on the playground. This was corrected during the inspection and removed off playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Caregiver arrived to the facility when inspector arrived. This left one caregiver with 17 children ages ranged from 5m-3yrs old alone in the building. This was corrected at inspection once caregiver walked into the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: During a follow up inspection, one caregiver was missing 9 hours of annual training for the annual training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: During a follow up inspection, one  caregiver was missing a high school diploma or the equivalent on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two caregivers personnel files were evaluated. Both were missing hours of annual training for the last annual training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director is missing hours of annual training for the last annual training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The director and two caregivers do not have pediatric first aid training on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: I observed a five month child lying on her stomach while sleeping.     Note: Corrected when the child was placed on her back.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: The director and two caregivers do not have pediatric CPR training on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: In the infant classroom, I observed a five month old child sleeping in a crib with a pacifier clipped to her shirt.     Note: Corrected when the pacifier and clip were removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation's emergency preparedness plan does not state how children 24 months and younger will evacuate during an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: I observed two children sleeping on mats that were not labeled by name or number.    Note Corrected when the mats were labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: There was no written documentation provided to the parents stating the operation does not carry liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of four children's files evaluated were missing current immunization records on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director did not provide CCR with accurate documentation during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: One out of two caregivers was missing a high school diploma or the equivalent on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))
